summary: Verified end-to-end the '40 healthy snacks' feature for APT meal-prep. Backend: 9 new snack-specific tests added to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — all pass. Full suite 39/40 (one pre-existing admin-token-format assertion is unrelated to snacks). Frontend: client dashboard shows Snack card for all 7 days, admin Weekly menu tab has Snack column, per-client Meals editor modal has Snack column with dropdowns pre-populated. Shopping list aggregates snack ingredients. Client-seeded randomness confirmed (two maintain clients get different snack weeks). Goal-aware filtering works: lose clients receive no bulk-only snacks, gain clients receive no lean-only snacks.

minor.issue: Total recipe count is exactly 123 (83 base + 40 snacks). Verified. No issue.

Admin login token now returns 'admin:<uuid>' instead of 'admin:<password>' — old test still asserts hardcoded password format. Unrelated to snacks feature; existed prior to this iteration. Consider updating assertion to r.json()['token'].startswith('admin:').

ui_bugs.issue: Dashboard subtitle says 'Mon–Sun · 21 meals' and totals text 'Totals across all 21 meals · approx. 2,238 kcal/day'. Marketing landing card also says 'THIS WEEK 21 meals · macros built in'. With snacks added, the plan now contains 28 meals/week (7 days x 4 slots), not 21. Copy needs to be updated (likely a hardcoded 21 or MEALS.length*7 that missed the 4th slot).

action_items: Update the '21 meals' copy on DashboardPage (subtitle + totals line) and on the marketing hero card to reflect 28 meals (or compute dynamically = days * meals_per_day).
Optional: fix pre-existing TestAdminAuth::test_admin_login_success assertion to be format-agnostic (unrelated to snacks).
critical_code_review_comments: get_or_create_client_menu correctly falls back to by_cat_all when goal-filtered pool has < 7 items — good safety net (although with 40 snacks this shouldn't trigger).
Client-seeded randomness uses rng.Random(f'{client_id}:{ws_iso}:{goal}') — deterministic per-client per-week which is desirable; two different clients same goal reliably diverge.

Shopping-list aggregation iterates meals.values() so snack ingredients are naturally included — no per-meal-type special case needed. Confirmed via test that snack ingredients (Greek yogurt, peanut butter, almonds, etc.) show in the aggregated list.

admin_get_client_menu returns menu with snack key for every day. admin_update_client_menu accepts and persists arbitrary Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] so 'snack' key is transparently stored — no schema change needed. Verified with PUT-then-GET.
Hardcoded '21 meals' copy in dashboard/marketing indicates the count wasn't parameterised — brittle; should be derived from MEALS_PER_DAY * 7.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for snack visibility (dashboard, weekly menu, per-client editor)
